nodes.description: Owned.owner: contract owner address, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor; used by onlyOwner.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner used for the two-step ownership transfer.
MedED.symbol: token symbol string ('MDED').
MedED.name: token name string ('Medical Education Token').
MedED.decimals: token decimals (18).
MedED._totalSupply: total token supply minted to a fixed address in the constructor.
MedED.balances: mapping(address => uint) holding token balances.
MedED.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding spend allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd: checked addition with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub: checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul: checked multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv: checked division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner, sets newOwner (two-step transfer start).
Owned.acceptOwnership: requires msg.sender == newOwner, then moves ownership.
MedED constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a fixed address.
MedED.totalSupply: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
MedED.balanceOf: returns balances[tokenOwner].
MedED.transfer: moves tokens from balances[msg.sender] to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
MedED.approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend check.
MedED.transferFrom: moves tokens using allowance allowed[from][msg.sender].
MedED.allowance: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
MedED.approveAndCall: sets allowance and then calls spender.receiveApproval (external callback).
MedED fallback: payable fallback that always reverts, rejecting ETH.
MedED.transferAnyERC20Token: onlyOwner, performs an external transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance bookkeeping.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) on an attacker-chosen contract, inside approveAndCall - reentrancy vector.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, caller-supplied contract address.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply, mapped to arithmetic.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller ownership rights.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before newOwner can be set.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is moved.
transferOwnership reads owner through the onlyOwner modifier check.
transferAnyERC20Token is onlyOwner and forwards tokens to owner.
acceptOwnership reads and then clears newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller address.
approveAndCall passes msg.sender into the external receiveApproval callback while allowance is already set.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
MedED constructor assigns _totalSupply from a literal and credits balances.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] on a raw uint state variable.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balances and allowance bookkeeping.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction on _totalSupply and balances[address(0)].
The unchecked subtraction reads the _totalSupply state variable.
approveAndCall executes an external call to spender.receiveApproval after state writes.
The callee contract can re-enter approveAndCall / transferFrom through the unchecked external callback.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call on an arbitrary token contract.
Parameter a is the first operand of safeAdd.
Parameter b is the second operand of safeAdd.
Parameter a is the first operand of safeSub.
Parameter b is the second operand of safeSub.
Parameter a is the first operand of safeMul.
Parameter b is the second operand of safeMul.
Parameter a is the first operand of safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor of safeDiv.
Parameter _newOwner becomes the pending owner newOwner.
Parameter 'to' receives the transferred tokens in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transfer.
Parameter spender receives the allowance in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount in approve.
Parameter 'from' is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner selects the first index of the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender selects the second index of the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender receives the allowance and is the external call target.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenOwner selects the balance returned by balanceOf.
Parameter tokenAddress is the arbitrary contract targeted by the external transfer call.
Parameter tokens is the amount passed to the external transfer call.
Local c holds the result returned by safeAdd.
